Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with acute low back strain and paraspinal muscle tenderness.
Over the course of 17 visits, care consisted of conservative management including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and
home stretching instruction. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the collision, and the
clinical picture aligns with the symptoms described. Several examination findings, including reduced lumbar range of motion and
localized muscle guarding, support the presence of a soft tissue injury, while neurological screening and straight leg raise testing
were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment invovling the same region of the back is known. Treatment followed a
typical progression, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms improved and function returned. Billed services correspond to the
care documented, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. Patient was discharged to independent home exercise with
instructions to return if symptoms recur.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
